nodes.label: Board Member Portrait 1 (night street, formal suit)
nodes.rationale: Photographic, ~3:2 landscape. Night exterior: a young person in a black suit and white shirt stands on a road beside a tree wrapped in warm string lights, head bowed, hands behind back, parked white sedan behind. Palette is near-monochrome black/navy with warm amber and gold point-lighting against a deep blue sky; high contrast, low key. A solemn, formal 'what we stand for' register rather than a casual headshot, so it reads as ethos-first portraiture for the leadership roster.

nodes.label: Board Member Story (leadership roster section)
nodes.rationale: The three board_member_N.jpg files are a set, not three unrelated assets: a repeating section that pairs a portrait with a name and a short personal story. The set deliberately mixes registers (formal suit, technologist, candid campfire) so the board reads as human individuals rather than a uniform executive headshot block.

nodes.label: Real-Photography Portrait Convention
nodes.rationale: The site signals authenticity by putting un-illustrated photographs of people on the page. Every human image in this asset set is a real photograph with real lighting rather than artwork, so the organisation's credibility rests on documentary evidence instead of mascot decoration.
